description: This file declares the TrustyConfirmationUI class, which implements the IConfirmationUI interface for handling user confirmation prompts and secure input events within the Android hardware confirmation UI framework. It includes method declarations, private members for session management, and references to external components such as GuestSession and communication channels.

classes.name: TrustyConfirmationUI
classes.description: A class implementing the confirmation UI interface for Trusty TEE, managing user prompts, secure input events, and session control within the Android hardware confirmation framework.

methods.name: promptUserConfirmation
methods.description: Initiates a user confirmation prompt with specified parameters, possibly returning early and handling asynchronous callbacks.

methods.name: deliverSecureInputEvent
methods.description: Handles the delivery of a secure input token to the UI session.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the current UI session if active.

methods.name: ConnectToHost
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the host via virtio-console.

methods.name: HostMessageFetcherLoop
methods.description: Loop running in a thread to fetch messages from the host.

methods.name: RunSession
methods.description: Starts a new confirmation session with provided parameters.

methods.name: GetVirtioConsoleDevicePath
methods.description: Returns the device path for the virtio console.
